paite: oseph tapa Manasseh suan a Manasseh tapa Makir, huai mi tapa Gilead, huai mi tapa Hepher tapa Jelophehad tanute ahong pai ua, atanute min, Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milkah leh Tirzah ahi uh.
heading: Jelophehad Tanute
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

paite: Kihoupihna puanin kongkhak ah Mosi, siampu Eleazar leh miliante leh omkhawmte tengteng ma a kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ah ava dingh uhi.
english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

paite: "Gamdai ah ka pu uh asi a, TOUPA kalh a kikhawm, Korah pawl ah atel kei. Himahleh amah khelh ziak in asi a, tapa anei kei hi.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against Yahweh in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

paite: Tapa aneih louh ziak lel in bangziak a ka pa uh min, asuante a pan mang ding ahia? Ka pa unaute lak ah tantuan hon pia un," achi uhi.
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

paite: Mosi in athu uh TOUPA ma ah atun hi.
english: Moses brought their cause before Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Jelophehad tanute'n ahihdik uhi. Apa uh unaute lak ah tantuan na bawlsak ding ahi. Apa uh tantuan na piak ding ahi.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

paite: Israel suante kiang ah mi tapa nei lou a asihleh agou atanute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

paite: Tanu aneih keileh agou a-unaute na piak ding uh ahi.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

paite: "Sanggam pasalte aneih keileh agou apa sanggam pasalte na piak ding uh ahi.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

paite: Apa'n sanggam pasalte aneih keileh agou atanau na pe ding ua, ama'n aluah ding hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a Israel suante a ding in vaihawmna dan thuseh kip ahi ding, chi in gen in," achi hi.
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Abarim tang ah hohtou inla, Israel suante ka piak ding gam va en in.
heading: Mosi Thakheng Ding In Joshua Tel Ahi / (Diu 31.1-8)
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

paite: Na muh khit chiang in na sanggampa Aaron achipihte kiang a pi ahih mah bang in nang leng pi na hita ding hi!
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

paite: Zin gamdai a omkhawmte aphun lai ua amitmuh ua tui a kei hon pahtawi dia ka hon thupiak kalh a na hel ziak in," achi hi. Huaite Zin gamdai a Kadesh a Meribah tuite ahi.
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

paite: Mosi in TOUPA ahoupih a,
english: Moses spoke to Yahweh, saying,

paite: "Omkhawm mipite tung a om ding mi khat, sa tengteng khate Pathian, TOUPA'N sep hen.
english: “Let Yahweh, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

paite: TOUPA mi omkhawmte chingtu nei lou belam bang a a-omlouhna ding un, ama uh kai ding, amaute pikhia a, pilut ding in," achi hi.
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of Yahweh may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Huai Kha omnapa Nun tapa Joshua pi inla, atung ah na khut nga in.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

paite: Siampu Eleazar leh omkhawm mipite ma ah dingsak inla, amitmuh un amah nna guan in.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

paite: Israel suante mipi omkhawm tengteng in athu aman theihna ding un atung ah na zahtakhuaina nga in.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

paite: Huchi in amah siampu Eleazar ma ah adingh dia, ama'n TOUPA ma ah Urim thu alaksak dia; athu in apawt ding ua, athu in alut ding uh; amah leh Israel suan tengteng, omkhawmte toh," achi hi.
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before Yahweh. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA thupiak bang in ahih a, Joshua api a, Eleazar leh omkhawmte ma ah adingsak hi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

paite: Huchi in atung ah akhut anga a, Mosi zang a TOUPA'N agen bang in nna aguanta hi.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
